videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video caption in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences. The content is about unauthorized ChatGPT Pro subscription charges.
Key points from the caption:
1. ChatGPT's expensive Pro plan (299,000 won/month) is being charged without authorization
2. Victims received notifications about sudden charges despite never entering card info
3. This month: 1,368 cases totaling about 400 million won, with 858 cases (250 million won) suspected as fraudulent
4. Someone acquired card numbers, expiration dates, birth years, and passwords to make payments
5. OpenAI stated it wasn't ChatGPT charging without consent, but stolen card info being used unauthorizedly - they've deactivated those payment methods
6. Domestic payment agency Nice Information & Communication canceled about 700 payments and is checking others, temporarily suspended new registrations and added phone verification
7. Financial Supervisory Service requested card companies to strengthen fraud detection
I need to write this in Korean only, no English, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences.
